purpose: This document contains 100 practical checks of the tasks a person can do in Avera. It is a separate, plain-language companion to the detailed testing report. Prepared November 1, 2026.

scenarios.title: Create an account
scenarios.summary: Check that the sign-up screen asks for email verification after valid details are entered.
scenarios.action: Register with a new test email and matching passwords; enter the verification code.
scenarios.expected: The sign-up screen asks for email verification after valid details are entered.
scenarios.outcome: GREEN — Earlier sample-data check passed. This user review has not been run live.

evidence.title: registration validates matching passwords and transitions to email verification

scenarios.title: Receive the verification email
scenarios.summary: Check that a real verification email arrives and its code completes registration.
scenarios.action: Register with a test email address you can open.
scenarios.expected: A real verification email arrives and its code completes registration.
scenarios.outcome: NOT TESTED — A live user check is still needed.

scenarios.summary: Check that the account is not submitted until the passwords match.
